title: jaboonga: reboonged
description: a dumb minecraft mod that completely enchances the way you see minecraft (trust me), contains epic looking blocks, automation, awesome pvp mechanics and more! try it yourself or with friends
body:
welcome to a complete remaster of the original mod jaboonga by me, the previous mod wasn't even uploaded to modrinth so i hope this one will be approved. i remade (almost) the entire mod and made it more fun (also in the previous mod there were things that could get this mod taken down via copyright so i remade them too)

WHAT THIS MOD CONTAINS:

-great pvp mechanics

-automation

-fascinating resources, weapons and armor

-its dumb.

... and funny!


this mod is basically something to spend time on, i made the progression really easy to understand, you check the advancements, recipe book and tooltips, it helps you understand what to do next, experiment with the items you have, craft new items, blocks and tools, and if you continue doing this you will become overpowered.

IN THIS MOD YOU CAN:

- farm john blocks and men blocks, the main resource of the mod. some of them can even help you in movement (like men blocks, they can fling you if you stand on them) just... make sure you dont die in the landing
- slay evil men and other creatures, in later stages you can even kill the EVILEST MAN, a boss which has around 1000 health (make sure to craft something called "evil jonathan", it helps beat the boss, and also build up like 5 blocks the boss won't get you)
- craft generators, reinforcers, smelters and automate your collection of john blocks, men, evil men and more using chests and hoppers
- become overpowered, after you slain the boss you obtain resources such as "evilest steel", using it you can craft evilest armor and evilest tools!

dont expect too much from this mod, its really just adds addicting progression and automation, if you want to try it out, feel free to download it! i will update it often and i would appreciate if you shared this mod with your friends (try to pvp in this mod and do your own crazy ideas, it adds a bunch of things that will make it fun, for example, when i was testing this with my friends we built castles and we raided eachother and stuff, it was really fun, you can try to do this too or make your own ideas!)
i hope you enjoy this mod!
